page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 72 dedicated physical cores and 72 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating systems and application data. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 33 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and cloud services.

This instance offers a high-density compute profile with dedicated CPU resources, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring predictable, non-shared processing power without the overhead of hyperthreading. The balanced CPU-to-memory ratio and high network bandwidth make it suitable for multi-threaded enterprise applications, web serving, distributed caching, and general-purpose backend workloads.
